description:
## Goal

Delete the debug-only end-of-product-session executable-effect freshness recomputation. Freshness remains correct by construction at the materialized-effect projection boundary, with focused preservation, invalidation, and callee-edge retraction tests owning the invariant.

## Delivered

- Removed `PullSession::assert_executable_effects_fresh` and the `finish_session` call. Session finish now only emits its balanced lifecycle event; it performs no product-graph traversal.
- Removed the unused public `executable_effects_inventory` accessor retained beside the auditor.
- Preserved `latest_effect_inputs`, `effect_dependents`, and `executable_effects`: these are production state, not audit scaffolding. Projection movement replaces exact reverse callee edges and invalidates the affected effect cone.
- Extended the focused effect-cone test to prove callee-edge removal invalidates and re-settles the former caller cone, retracts the removed effect, and prevents later callee changes from invalidating former callers.
- Folded two duplicate effect fixture builders into one correct-by-construction helper. Its input is only the representable `allocates` decision; it constructs both the body and exact `EffectSummary`, so unrelated effect flags cannot contradict the body. Focused production pulls prove exact default and allocating summaries.
- Updated the pipeline authority documentation. The actual `ExecutableEffects` SCC/cone producer remains unchanged for fz-tfn.8.

## Deterministic proof

A temporary switch, removed before the approved commit, ran fz-tfn.31 consolidated observations with the normal auditor in the first compiler process and only the auditor disabled in the second. All three target fixtures passed one exact comparison over six subprocesses: runtime output, byte-identical canonical backend artifacts, canonical formula and product causal work, product generations, cache/displacement behavior, invalidation/retraction movement, recursive membership, and balanced lifecycle inventory were unchanged.

The complete single-thread fixture matrix passed on both sides of deletion in the same isolated Cargo target:

- auditor enabled: 525 passed, 3 intentionally ignored, 0 failed
- auditor deleted: 525 passed, 3 intentionally ignored, 0 failed

The unaudited matrix took 159.73s versus 162.02s audited. Duration is corroborative only; the exact causal/artifact comparison and identical matrix populations are authoritative.

Focused effect proofs pass for default and allocating body/projection concordance, unchanged rematerialization, exact transitive invalidation, callee-edge retraction, and symbolic mutual recursion.

## Gates

- library: 1,774 passed, 6 intentionally ignored, 0 failed
- fz2 CLI: 29 passed, 0 failed
- workspace doctests: 0 run, 1 intentionally ignored, 0 failed
- `cargo check --workspace --all-targets`
- `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- `cargo fmt --all -- --check`
- `git diff --check`

The ticket commit removes 63 net lines across production code, focused fixtures, and authoritative documentation. No temporary switch, probe, counter, or environment affordance remains.

## Delivery

A ticket-scoped cold adversarial review approved exact staged SHA-256 `bb972988565ae4e7b8d005cf5ed2175e09cc7bdc047b94723a82230f0ec0a37d` after rejecting and correcting the overly broad fixture input. Commit `78aef7e08` was created once, the ticket was closed once, and the topology-preserving push updated `fz-tfn/long-lived-recalculator` for draft PR #118. PR #118 still targets `wt/kdt-close`; PR #110 and GitHub stack #120 remain unchanged.

Exact pushed head `78aef7e085fdc49f973f02994b48f672147ad28d` produced one CI workflow, run 33884470026, with no duplicate to cancel. Lint passed from 14:34:02 to 14:34:42 UTC in 40 seconds. The coverage-backed test job passed from 14:34:02 to 14:59:44 UTC in 25 minutes 42 seconds. The badge job skipped normally for a pull-request run.
title: Delete the end-of-session executable-effect freshness mini-pass
